fast_path_cdl_preconditions: all blocker-class Row 21r scope items resolved by named spec text or explicitly routed to a later SENSITIVE CDL before activation
fast-path CDL prompt cites this readiness artifact and the Row 21r completion artifact
BLS signer activation remains false unless separately authorized by a SENSITIVE phase
no wallet, settlement, minting, monthly-close, public-RC, mainnet, or epoch transition claim is made by the CDL opening
fast_path_ecu_cdl_open_precondition_note: This token records that gap dispositions are complete. GAP-ECU-FAST-PATH-CDL-OPEN-00 requires Row 21r and any named blocker-resolution artifacts in addition to this token.

atomic_nullifier_reservation_gate.disposition_summary: Parallel submissions must not pass duplicate checks before either nullifier write commits.
atomic_nullifier_reservation_gate.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify atomic check-and-reserve nullifier semantics before admission.

bloom_prefilter_only_with_exact_recovery.disposition_summary: Probabilistic filters may route work but cannot be final value-bearing duplicate authority.
bloom_prefilter_only_with_exact_recovery.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify Bloom as prefilter-only with exact recovery and canonical nullifier store confirmation.

bls_signer_roster_reference_and_activati.disposition_summary: Shard-boundary aggregate labels must not imply live BLS signer authority.
bls_signer_roster_reference_and_activati.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify roster-reference format and the inactive BLS boundary; any activation remains a later SENSITIVE CDL/guard-clear phase.

canonical_checkpoint_tree_and_inclusion_.disposition_summary: Checkpoint roots and inclusion proofs need one canonical tree algorithm and verifier binding.
canonical_checkpoint_tree_and_inclusion_.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must select the canonical tree/proof verifier and fail-closed tokens.

challenge_rate_limit_deposit_and_priorit.disposition_summary: Challenge flooding must not make honest checkpoints indefinitely unavailable.
challenge_rate_limit_deposit_and_priorit.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define challenge rate limits, deposit or cost controls, and deterministic priority.

challenge_sampling_floor_independent_of_.disposition_summary: High reputation must not remove minimum challenge/audit coverage.
challenge_sampling_floor_independent_of_.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define a reputation-independent sampling floor for close-facing receipt checks.

challenge_window_state_machine_and_proof.disposition_summary: Challenge windows need proof availability, finality, partial exclusion, and settlement-consumption rules.
challenge_window_state_machine_and_proof.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define the challenge/audit proof protocol and state machine.

challenge_window_state_machine_gap.disposition_summary: Unresolved challenges must block affected checkpoint consumption.
challenge_window_state_machine_gap.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify open/resolved/expired/final states and checkpoint ineligibility behavior.

durable_append_before_ack_and_idempotent.disposition_summary: Receipt admission must append durably before acknowledgement and replay must be idempotent after restart.
durable_append_before_ack_and_idempotent.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify durable append-before-ack and deterministic replay behavior.

durable_queue_log_backpressure_design.disposition_summary: Trillion-scale ingestion cannot rely on unbounded memory or silent drop.
durable_queue_log_backpressure_design.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify durable queue/log writer, bounded overflow, and recovery behavior.

exact_nullifier_store_false_positive_rec.disposition_summary: A global nullifier rule is only safe with exact storage and recovery from probabilistic prefilter false positives.
exact_nullifier_store_false_positive_rec.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify exact nullifier store semantics and Bloom false-positive recovery.

genesis_policy_reference_projection_gate.disposition_summary: Genesis-sourced value receipts require CDL-110 policy certificate references before projection eligibility.
genesis_policy_reference_projection_gate.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must bind GenesisValueActionPolicyCertificate reference verification and cache/failure rules.

global_nullifier_cap_and_admission_accou.disposition_summary: Shard splitting must not evade global caps or admission accounting.
global_nullifier_cap_and_admission_accou.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define global nullifier cap accounting across shards.

inclusion_proof_verifier_binding_gap.disposition_summary: Invalid inclusion proofs must fail closed against checkpoint roots.
inclusion_proof_verifier_binding_gap.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must bind inclusion proof verifier, tree algorithm, and rejection tokens.

manifest_root_completeness_and_receipt_r.disposition_summary: Checkpoint manifests must commit to complete receipt and nullifier roots without selective omission.
manifest_root_completeness_and_receipt_r.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify manifest completeness and root-binding proofs.

private_public_proof_boundary_from_rows_.disposition_summary: Private-local evidence needs an explicit publication/proof boundary before close-facing use.
private_public_proof_boundary_from_rows_.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify private/public proof-boundary handling and admissible proof classes.

private_public_proof_boundary_gap.disposition_summary: Private-local evidence represented as public evidence is projection-ineligible without disclosure, anchor, or proof.
private_public_proof_boundary_gap.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define private boundary proof formats and rejection rules.

projection_family_adjudication_gap.disposition_summary: The same source event across competing projection families needs routing/composition/adjudication rules.
projection_family_adjudication_gap.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define projection-family registry/adjudication rules or route unresolved families to a later CDL before activation.

proof_availability_timeout_and_checkpoin.disposition_summary: Withheld proofs must make affected checkpoints ineligible rather than silently surviving challenge windows.
proof_availability_timeout_and_checkpoin.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define proof availability timeouts and checkpoint ineligibility rules.

receipt_economic_admissibility_and_servi.disposition_summary: Receipt volume alone must not create close-facing credit without admissibility and quality evidence.
receipt_economic_admissibility_and_servi.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify service/economic admissibility and quality-evidence minimums.

receipt_status_commitment_and_transition.disposition_summary: Receipt status must be committed and transition-proofed before challenge or settlement consumption.
receipt_status_commitment_and_transition.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define status commitment and transition proof rules.

receipt_status_integrity_gate_gap.disposition_summary: Failed, partial, replayed, or superseded receipts cannot be relabeled as succeeded to create projection eligibility.
receipt_status_integrity_gate_gap.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must bind receipt status to source evidence and fail closed on mismatches.

root_committed_novelty_and_quality_evide.disposition_summary: Backward-attribution novelty and quality signals must be root-committed and independently verifiable.
root_committed_novelty_and_quality_evide.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must cite CDL-108 hybrid_merkle_proof requirements and bind novelty/quality evidence roots.

sender_authorization_projection_gate_gap.disposition_summary: Transfer-like receipts need CDL-066-compatible sender authorization before projection eligibility.
sender_authorization_projection_gate_gap.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must bind sender_authorization_ref proof shape, verification order, and rejection token.

service_receipt_attempt_cap_and_value_ev.disposition_summary: Service receipt spam needs attempt caps and value evidence before close-facing use.
service_receipt_attempt_cap_and_value_ev.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define attempt caps and value-evidence thresholds.

settlement_consumer_proof_selection_rule.disposition_summary: Slow-path consumers need deterministic proof-selection rules instead of raw receipt flood or unchecked root-only trust.
settlement_consumer_proof_selection_rule.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define normal-path and challenge-path proof selection rules.

sybil_diversity_and_independent_origin_g.disposition_summary: Sender authorization alone does not prove independent origin or non-Sybil contribution.
sybil_diversity_and_independent_origin_g.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must define diversity floors or route diversity thresholds to a named governance phase before activation.

OQ1_canonical_hash_tree_choice.disposition_summary: Production receipt roots need one canonical tree family.
OQ1_canonical_hash_tree_choice.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must choose binary Merkle, sparse Merkle, Verkle, or named ILC-native root and define proof bytes.

OQ2_minimal_registered_fast_signer_schem.disposition_summary: Local receipt signer schemes must be registered and fail-closed before any aggregate checkpoint use.
OQ2_minimal_registered_fast_signer_schem.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify the local receipt signer baseline and keep BLS activation out of scope unless later authorized.

OQ3_private_topology_preserving_shard_me.disposition_summary: Shard assignment must be deterministic enough to audit without leaking private topology.
OQ3_private_topology_preserving_shard_me.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must specify opaque shard_id derivation and privacy constraints.

OQ4_privacy_preserving_proof_eligibility.disposition_summary: The system must define which receipts may use privacy-preserving proofs instead of public source disclosure.
OQ4_privacy_preserving_proof_eligibility.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must classify receipt/proof eligibility and route unresolved privacy classes to a later governance phase.

OQ5_exact_challenge_window_durations.disposition_summary: Challenge windows need exact duration and timing semantics calibrated against high-volume cost/latency.
OQ5_exact_challenge_window_durations.resolution_path: GAP-ECU-RECEIPT-ROLLUP-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC-00 must lock candidate challenge-window durations or name the required SIM before CDL opening.

row_21r_scope_items: durable queue/log writer and overflow recovery
exact global nullifier store with atomic reservation
Bloom prefilter plus exact recovery boundary
canonical checkpoint tree and inclusion-proof verifier
challenge-window state machine, proof availability, rate limits, and priority
sender authorization and Genesis policy-reference proof binding
receipt status commitment and transition proof
economic admissibility, service quality, attempt caps, diversity floors, novelty/quality roots, and cap accounting
private/public proof boundary and shard-membership privacy constraints
BLS roster-reference format and inactive activation boundary
